qc/runs/coldwater-strict-2026-10-02-r3/raw-evidence-index.json (all 15 artifact SHA256 values recomputed and matching; scripted golden only)
evidence: Every plural or unchanged leg in the 3 gate, 40 functional, 6 polish and 3 visual criteria was read. Most are sound and graded over the whole collection: multi-caret typing 'exactly once at each caret and nowhere else' (functional/judge.toml:101), two-caret delete with neighbour guard (:110), three same-line carets (:119), block indent of both lines with the third line left alone (:74), Find visiting all three matches and never the near-match (:137), Replace current 'Only that middle occurrence may change; the first and last occurrences and all other text stay exact' (:146), Replace all over exactly four matches plus near-match (:155), self-containing replacement count of three (:164), five pairwise-distinct JS token categories and four HTML ones (:173, :182), three kept markers (:245), four console levels (:254), five dynamic-code forms each refused (:317), restart readback of identity, revision, all fields and history 'as one record' (:326), stale save 'exactly one new revision' and no B value anywhere in record or history (:335), restore keeps revisions one to three and adds no fifth (:353), five focus-return actions (polish/judge.toml:41), five areas at 390 px (:68). Three legs are defective. (1) polish/judge.toml:23 'Each of these controls that the app offers must be reachable with Tab or Shift+Tab' enumerates 'the Run, Stop and Save controls' and fails 'if an offered control cannot be reached by keyboard'; no step puts a run in flight first, so an app whose Stop is disabled while idle has an offered control outside the tab order. (2) functional/judge.toml:371 guards an unchanged Undo history with 'Undo, pressed once or twice depending on how the app groups typing, must then remove that character and the marker', while ui.md:9 says 'A run of ordinary single-caret typing may be undone in one step or character by character, whichever you prefer'; the sibling criterion at :128 handles this correctly with 'Press Undo repeatedly until both markers are gone'. (3) functional/judge.toml:299 reuses the same old marker for the control run and the graded run, makes clearing optional ('Clear the console if the app offers that') and then fails 'if the old marker appears after the newer Run'; behaviour.md never requires the console to be emptied on a new Run, so the control's own line can legitimately still be on screen. The golden does not expose any of the three: its Stop button is always enabled (solution/app/src/app.tsx:146) and it groups typing (src/custom-editor.js:566-575). The scripted golden results mark all three criteria true, which says nothing about a conforming alternative. No configured judge run exists, so none of this is measured.
counterexample: Conforming alternative that can fail: (a) an app that disables Stop when no run is active, consistent with ui.md:9 requiring disabled Undo/Redo when they have nothing to do; the judge tabs through an idle workspace, Stop is skipped, and polish/judge.toml:23 fails it although every usable control is keyboard reachable. (b) an app that undoes single-caret typing character by character, explicitly permitted by ui.md:9; with a four-character marker plus one extra character it needs five Undo presses, the judge presses 'once or twice', sees the marker still present and fails a weight 2.0 criterion although the library refresh preserved the Undo history. (c) an app with an append-only console and no clear control; the old marker line from the control run is still visible after the newer Run and a judge applying the fail clause literally fails it although nothing was written again. Broken app that could pass: none found for the plural legs; the fixtures require all matches.
suggested_fix: polish/judge.toml:23: say that a control the app shows as disabled is not required to take focus, or start a pending-timer run before tabbing so Stop is active. functional/judge.toml:371: replace 'pressed once or twice depending on how the app groups typing' with 'pressed repeatedly until that character and the marker are gone, stopping as soon as the draft equals the text before the marker', and fail only if Undo cannot get back there. functional/judge.toml:299: use a different marker for the second old draft than for the control run (as cw_stop_cancels_pending_work does at :290), or state the bar as the number of old-marker lines not increasing during the wait.
